name: Cleave
description: Hit up to 2 additional adjacent enemies.

name: Second Wind
description: Once per fight, heal 20% max HP for free (no Ions).

name: Guard Break
description: Bypass a portion of the target's armor.

name: Rally
description: Nearby NPC allies gain a temporary damage buff.

name: Juggernaut
description: Temporary damage reduction stance.

name: Executioner
description: Bonus damage vs. targets below 25% HP.

name: Mend
description: Single-target heal (Ion cost).

name: Bless
description: Temporary to-hit/damage buff for self or target.

name: Turn Undead
description: Strong bonus damage + fear vs. undead-tagged monsters.

name: Circle Heal
description: Heal self + adjacent party/NPC allies.

name: Resurrect Lite
description: Revive a fallen ally NPC with partial HP (rare, long cooldown).

name: Sanctuary
description: Brief immunity window.

name: Backstab
description: Bonus damage on the first hit against an undamaged target.

name: Vanish
description: Brief stealth that guarantees your next attack crits.

name: Poison Blade
description: Attacks apply a damage-over-time effect for several rounds.

name: Shadow Step
description: Instantly reposition to strike an ally's target, hitting twice this round.

name: Fence's Favor
description: Permanent store discount: buy cheaper, sell for more.

name: Death Mark
description: Mark a target; all damage against it is increased for the rest of the fight.

name: Firebolt
description: Single-target burst damage spell (Ion cost).

name: Chain Lightning
description: Damage that arcs to a second nearby enemy.

name: Arcane Overload
description: Your next spell costs no Ions and deals bonus damage.

name: Meteor
description: Area damage hitting every enemy in the fight.

name: Mana Well
description: Passively regenerate Ions faster.

name: Cataclysm
description: Capstone: a massive area nuke on a long cooldown.

name: Slow
description: Reduce a target's Speed for several rounds.

name: Blink
description: Short-range teleport to escape or reposition.

name: Weaken
description: Reduce a target's attack power for the rest of the fight.

name: Mirror Image
description: Create a decoy that absorbs one hit.

name: Time Skip
description: Briefly act twice in a row.

name: Banish
description: Capstone: remove a non-boss enemy from the fight entirely.
